jp: 超重力崩壊に巻き込まれた一匹のジラ。不安定な異空間を漂ううちにその身体は様々なものを取り込んで再構成された。エネルギーを吸収し、体内の結晶から自分の複製体を生み出していく。
jp_grezzo: "超重力崩壊に巻き込まれた一匹のジラ。不安定な異空間を漂ううちにその身体は様々なものを取り込んで再構成された。エネルギーを吸収し、体内の結晶から自分の複製体を生み出していく。"
en: A lone zilla caught in a hypergravity collapse. As it drifted through the unstable space its body took in various things and reconfigured itself. It absorbs energy and creates a duplicate of itself from the crystals in its body.
en_grezzo: "A lone zilla caught in a hypergravity collapse. As it drifted through the unstable space its body took in various things and reconfigured itself. It absorbs energy and creates a duplicate of itself from the crystals in its body."
it: Uno zilla rimasto preso in un collasso di gravità estrema. Mentre andava alla deriva in uno spazio anomalo e instabile, il corpo gli si è ricomposto inglobando ogni sorta di cose. Assorbe energia e dai cristalli che ha dentro genera copie di sé stesso.

jp: 闇にまぎれて獲物を狙う、雀の妖怪。対象を追跡し、視力を奪い襲い掛かる。普通の雀と違って夜行性だが、夜更かしならぬ朝更かしして起きている個体も少なくないので油断してはいけない。
jp_grezzo: "闇にまぎれて獲物を狙う、雀の妖怪。対象を追跡し、視力を奪い襲い掛かる。普通の雀と違って夜行性だが、夜更かしならぬ朝更かしして起きている個体も少なくないので油断してはいけない。"
en: A sparrow demon that seeks its prey under the cover of darkness. It tracks the target takes away their sight and attacks them. Unlike the common sparrow it is nocturnal although there are many individuals who stay up late in the morning so don't let your guard down.
en_grezzo: "A sparrow demon that seeks its prey under the cover of darkness. It tracks the target takes away their sight and attacks them. Unlike the common sparrow it is nocturnal although there are many individuals who stay up late in the morning so don't let your guard down."
it: Un passero stregato che punta la preda approfittando del buio. La insegue, le toglie la vista e le salta addosso. A differenza del passero comune è notturno, ma attenzione: non pochi, invece di fare le ore piccole la notte, le fanno la mattina.

jp: 国家機密から個人の性癖まで幅広くカバーする情報屋。幾度となく消されそうになっているが、修羅場をくぐり抜けていく内に尋常じゃないほど強くなった。関係者の弱みを完全掌握した現在は手を出されていない。
jp_grezzo: "国家機密から個人の性癖まで幅広くカバーする情報屋。幾度となく消されそうになっているが、修羅場をくぐり抜けていく内に尋常じゃないほど強くなった。関係者の弱みを完全掌握した現在は手を出されていない。"
en: An informant who covers a wide range of topics from state secrets to personal proclivities. She has been almost killed many times but she has become extremely strong as she has gone through the rounds. The weaknesses of those involved have been fully seized and she is now untouched.
en_grezzo: "An informant who covers a wide range of topics from state secrets to personal proclivities. She has been almost killed many times but she has become extremely strong as she has gone through the rounds. The weaknesses of those involved have been fully seized and she is now untouched."
it: Un'informatrice che copre di tutto, dai segreti di stato ai gusti privati della gente. L'hanno data per morta un'infinità di volte, ma a furia di uscire dai guai è diventata forte oltre ogni misura. Adesso che ha in mano i punti deboli di tutti gli interessati, non la tocca più nessuno.

jp: 破壊衝動の塊のような悪魔。破壊の神が再生のために破壊を行うのに対し、こちらは形あるものを壊すのが快感なだけらしい。特に美しい物を無惨なまでに粉々にするのが好き。
jp_grezzo: "破壊衝動の塊のような悪魔。破壊の神が再生のために破壊を行うのに対し、こちらは形あるものを壊すのが快感なだけらしい。特に美しい物を無惨なまでに粉々にするのが好き。"
en: A demon like a mass of destructive impulses. It seems that the God of Creation destroys for the sake of rebirth while the God of Destruction only feels pleasure in destroying tangible things. He especially likes to ruthlessly shatter beautiful things.
en_grezzo: "A demon like a mass of destructive impulses. It seems that the God of Creation destroys for the sake of rebirth while the God of Destruction only feels pleasure in destroying tangible things. He especially likes to ruthlessly shatter beautiful things."
it: Un demone che pare fatto tutto di impulso distruttivo. Il dio della distruzione distrugge per far rinascere, mentre a questo, a quanto pare, rompere le cose che hanno una forma dà soltanto piacere. Ridurre in pezzi le cose belle, e senza pietà, è quello che gli riesce meglio.

jp: 鳥の特徴を一部備えており、さらに耳のようなものもあるためこの名で呼ばれる。過去の文献には喋り方が彼らと酷似している機械の記述があり、遥か昔から偵察機械を送り込んでいたのではないかと噂される。
jp_grezzo: "鳥の特徴を一部備えており、さらに耳のようなものもあるためこの名で呼ばれる。過去の文献には喋り方が彼らと酷似している機械の記述があり、遥か昔から偵察機械を送り込んでいたのではないかと噂される。"
en: It is called by this name because it has some of the characteristics of a bird plus some of the ears. There is a description of a machine that speaks very similarly to them in the past and it is rumored that a reconnaissance machine was sent in from long ago.
en_grezzo: "It is called by this name because it has some of the characteristics of a bird plus some of the ears. There is a description of a machine that speaks very similarly to them in the past and it is rumored that a reconnaissance machine was sent in from long ago."
it: Si chiama così perché ha qualche tratto da uccello e per giunta due cose che sembrano orecchie. In certi scritti antichi si parla di una macchina che parlava in un modo somigliantissimo al suo, e c'è chi mormora che di lassù mandino macchine in ricognizione da tempi remoti.

jp: 鋼のように鍛え上げられたすさまじい筋肉を誇る黒い牛人。そこら辺のミノタウロスとは比較にならないほどのパワーファイターだが足元がお留守で、脛やら膝やらを怪我して戦闘不能になることも。
jp_grezzo: "鋼のように鍛え上げられたすさまじい筋肉を誇る黒い牛人。そこら辺のミノタウロスとは比較にならないほどのパワーファイターだが足元がお留守で、脛やら膝やらを怪我して戦闘不能になることも。"
en: A black ox-man boasting tremendous muscles that are built like steel. He is a power fighter in comparison to the Minotaur but he is not always on his feet and he is sometimes unable to fight due to injuries to his shins and knees.
en_grezzo: "A black ox-man boasting tremendous muscles that are built like steel. He is a power fighter in comparison to the Minotaur but he is not always on his feet and he is sometimes unable to fight due to injuries to his shins and knees."
it: Un uomo-toro nero che va fiero di una muscolatura spaventosa, temprata come l'acciaio. Come lottatore di potenza il primo minotauro che capita non gli sta nemmeno vicino, però ha la guardia bassa da terra in giù, e capita che si azzoppi a uno stinco o a un ginocchio e resti fuori combattimento.

jp: 第一期文明さえ生まれる遥か昔から、再生・分裂を繰り返して生きてきた偉大なる大先輩。悠久の時を過ごす内に魔力を蓄えて進化を遂げ、空中での活動も可能になった。実はコラーゲンたっぷりで美容にいい。
jp_grezzo: "第一期文明さえ生まれる遥か昔から、再生・分裂を繰り返して生きてきた偉大なる大先輩。悠久の時を過ごす内に魔力を蓄えて進化を遂げ、空中での活動も可能になった。実はコラーゲンたっぷりで美容にいい。"
en: A great great elder who has lived through repeated rebirth and division since long before even the first civilization was born. As it spent its eternity it accumulated magical power and evolved allowing it to operate in the air. In fact it is full of collagen and good for your beauty.
en_grezzo: "A great great elder who has lived through repeated rebirth and division since long before even the first civilization was born. As it spent its eternity it accumulated magical power and evolved allowing it to operate in the air. In fact it is full of collagen and good for your beauty."
it: Un venerabile anziano che campa da molto prima che nascesse perfino la prima civiltà, rigenerandosi e dividendosi senza sosta. Nell'eternità che ha attraversato ha accumulato potere magico e si è evoluto, tanto da riuscire a muoversi anche in aria. E, per inciso, è pieno di collagene e fa bene alla pelle.

jp: 宇宙の海をまたにかける伝説の勇者鮫の子孫。宇宙でも空でも海でも活動できる掟破りの海賊野郎。黄金の地とされる、先祖の生まれ故郷を探すうちにイルヴァに辿りついた。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙の海をまたにかける伝説の勇者鮫の子孫。宇宙でも空でも海でも活動できる掟破りの海賊野郎。黄金の地とされる、先祖の生まれ故郷を探すうちにイルヴァに辿りついた。"
en: A descendant of the legendary brave shark that ventured across the seas of space. He's a law-breaking pirate who can operate in space in the air and at sea. While searching for his ancestral birthplace which is said to be the land of gold he found himself in Irva.
en_grezzo: "A descendant of the legendary brave shark that ventured across the seas of space. He's a law-breaking pirate who can operate in space in the air and at sea. While searching for his ancestral birthplace which is said to be the land of gold he found himself in Irva."
it: Discende dal leggendario squalo valoroso che solcava i mari dello spazio. È un pirata che se ne infischia di ogni regola, e sa muoversi nello spazio, in cielo e in mare. Cercando la terra natale dei suoi antenati, che dicono sia la terra dell'oro, è finito a Irva.

jp: 精霊が鮫を象って実体化した存在。ネバーギブアップの精神を持ち粘り強いが、戦闘力に関してはそこまで高くない。一応、鼻先はチタンよりも硬く、鋭い歯は大岩も噛み砕くらしい。
jp_grezzo: "精霊が鮫を象って実体化した存在。ネバーギブアップの精神を持ち粘り強いが、戦闘力に関してはそこまで高くない。一応、鼻先はチタンよりも硬く、鋭い歯は大岩も噛み砕くらしい。"
en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a shark. It has the spirit of never-give-up and is tenacious but its combat power is not that high. Apparently the tip of its nose is harder than titanium and its sharp teeth can chew through even large rocks.
en_grezzo: "A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a shark. It has the spirit of never-give-up and is tenacious but its combat power is not that high. Apparently the tip of its nose is harder than titanium and its sharp teeth can chew through even large rocks."
it: Uno spirito che ha preso corpo nella forma di uno squalo. Non molla mai ed è tenace, ma quanto a forza in combattimento non è che vada tanto in là. Comunque pare che abbia la punta del muso più dura del titanio, e che con quei denti aguzzi sbricioli anche i massi.

jp: 仲間との連携を基本戦術とする鮫。最前線で直接攻撃する仲間たちが傷ついていくのを嫌というほど目にしており、自責の念から自分自身も悪夢でよくうなされている。
jp_grezzo: "仲間との連携を基本戦術とする鮫。最前線で直接攻撃する仲間たちが傷ついていくのを嫌というほど目にしており、自責の念から自分自身も悪夢でよくうなされている。"
en: A shark whose basic tactics are to cooperate with his companions. He has seen his comrades who attack directly on the front lines get hurt so badly that he often has nightmares himself because of his own remorse.
en_grezzo: "A shark whose basic tactics are to cooperate with his companions. He has seen his comrades who attack directly on the front lines get hurt so badly that he often has nightmares himself because of his own remorse."
it: Uno squalo che come tattica di fondo si coordina con i compagni. Ha visto fin troppe volte farsi male quelli che stanno in prima linea e attaccano di persona, e il rimorso glielo fa rivedere di notte: gli incubi non gli danno tregua.

jp: 妄人はワンニンと読む。邪気に侵され半分冷蔵庫になってしまった人間。妄想し続けないと自我を失い完全に冷蔵庫になってしまう状態にある。属性攻撃を一部吸収し、即座に射出することができる。
jp_grezzo: "妄人はワンニンと読む。邪気に侵され半分冷蔵庫になってしまった人間。妄想し続けないと自我を失い完全に冷蔵庫になってしまう状態にある。属性攻撃を一部吸収し、即座に射出することができる。"
en: A person who has been invaded by evil spirits and has become half a refrigerator. It is in a state where if it does not continue to fantasize it will lose its ego and become a complete fridge. It absorbs some of the attribute attacks and can be immediately ejected.
en_grezzo: "A person who has been invaded by evil spirits and has become half a refrigerator. It is in a state where if it does not continue to fantasize it will lose its ego and become a complete fridge. It absorbs some of the attribute attacks and can be immediately ejected."
it: Wangnin si scrive con i caratteri del delirio. È un uomo che, invaso dal soffio maligno, è diventato per metà un frigorifero: se smette di vaneggiare perde l'io e si trasforma in frigorifero del tutto. Assorbe una parte degli attacchi elementali e li può risputare all'istante.

jp: メシェーラの特性を最大限に引き出せるよう人体改造と投薬を行った結果、適合できずに変異してしまった。新鮮な肉体がベースになっているためか、レミード遺跡のオリジナルメシェーラよりもよっぽど強い。
jp_grezzo: "メシェーラの特性を最大限に引き出せるよう人体改造と投薬を行った結果、適合できずに変異してしまった。新鮮な肉体がベースになっているためか、レミード遺跡のオリジナルメシェーラよりもよっぽど強い。"
en: As a result of human modification and medication to get the best out of Meshera's characteristics she was unable to adapt and mutated. Perhaps because it's based on fresh flesh it's much stronger than the original Meshera in the Rehmido Ruins.
en_grezzo: "As a result of human modification and medication to get the best out of Meshera's characteristics she was unable to adapt and mutated. Perhaps because it's based on fresh flesh it's much stronger than the original Meshera in the Rehmido Ruins."
it: L'hanno rimaneggiata nel corpo e riempita di farmaci per tirar fuori il meglio dalle proprietà del Meshera, ma non ha retto e le è venuto un difetto. Forse perché è partita da carne fresca, è molto più forte del Meshera originale che sta nelle Rovine di Remido.

jp: ほぼ全ての状態異常と属性が効かない巨人。その真の力は神に匹敵すると言われるが、いつも寝ており闘うところを見るのは困難。数少ない戦闘目撃証言によると寝ぼけて武器を使わず素手で殴っていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "ほぼ全ての状態異常と属性が効かない巨人。その真の力は神に匹敵すると言われるが、いつも寝ており闘うところを見るのは困難。数少ない戦闘目撃証言によると寝ぼけて武器を使わず素手で殴っていたらしい。"
en: A giant with almost all health problems and no attributes. It is said that his true power is comparable to that of a god but he is always sleeping and it is difficult to see him fight. According to the few witness accounts of the battle he was sleepy and struck with his bare hands without using a weapon.
en_grezzo: "A giant with almost all health problems and no attributes. It is said that his true power is comparable to that of a god but he is always sleeping and it is difficult to see him fight. According to the few witness accounts of the battle he was sleepy and struck with his bare hands without using a weapon."
it: Un gigante su cui non fa presa quasi nessuna alterazione e nessun elemento. Dicono che la sua vera forza sia pari a quella di un dio, ma dorme sempre ed è difficile vederlo combattere. Le poche testimonianze che ci sono raccontano che menava a mani nude, mezzo addormentato, senza nemmeno prendere un'arma.

jp: 見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、未来に大きく干渉する力を秘めている。その羽ばたきは極めて微小なものだが、巡り巡って大嵐を起こす決定的な要因にもなり得るのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、未来に大きく干渉する力を秘めている。その羽ばたきは極めて微小なものだが、巡り巡って大嵐を起こす決定的な要因にもなり得るのだとか。"
en: It may look like just a large butterfly but it has the power to interfere with the future. The fluttering of the wings is extremely minute but it can be a decisive factor in causing a huge storm.
en_grezzo: "It may look like just a large butterfly but it has the power to interfere with the future. The fluttering of the wings is extremely minute but it can be a decisive factor in causing a huge storm."
it: A vederla sembra soltanto una farfalla di taglia grossa, e invece nasconde il potere di interferire pesantemente col futuro. Quel suo battito d'ali è una cosa piccolissima, eppure pare che di rimando in rimando possa diventare la causa decisiva di una tempesta.

jp: 過去の文明で生み出された生体兵器の子孫。鱗粉のように見えるものは物質を作り変える性質を持っており、攻撃に使えば体を蝕む毒、防御に使えば薬となる。先祖はもっと強大で、文明をひとつ滅ぼしたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "過去の文明で生み出された生体兵器の子孫。鱗粉のように見えるものは物質を作り変える性質を持っており、攻撃に使えば体を蝕む毒、防御に使えば薬となる。先祖はもっと強大で、文明をひとつ滅ぼしたらしい。"
en: The descendants of biological weapons produced by past civilizations. What appears to be scales has the ability to alter its property becoming a poison to consume the body when used for offense and a medicine when used for defense. Apparently their ancestors were more powerful and destroyed one civilization.
en_grezzo: "The descendants of biological weapons produced by past civilizations. What appears to be scales has the ability to alter its property becoming a poison to consume the body when used for offense and a medicine when used for defense. Apparently their ancestors were more powerful and destroyed one civilization."
it: Discende dalle armi biologiche costruite da una civiltà del passato. Quella che sembra la polvere delle ali ha la proprietà di rifare la materia: usata per attaccare è un veleno che rode il corpo, usata per difendere è una medicina. Pare che gli antenati fossero ben più potenti, e che una civiltà l'abbiano distrutta davvero.

jp: 見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、実は訓練されたアサシン。無害な蝶のように舞い寄り、蜂のように刺す。見た目に騙されてはいけないのだ。
jp_grezzo: "見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、実は訓練されたアサシン。無害な蝶のように舞い寄り、蜂のように刺す。見た目に騙されてはいけないのだ。"
en: Although it looks like just a large butterfly it is actually a trained assassin. It flutters like a harmless butterfly and stings like a bee. Don't be fooled by appearances.
en_grezzo: "Although it looks like just a large butterfly it is actually a trained assassin. It flutters like a harmless butterfly and stings like a bee. Don't be fooled by appearances."
it: A vederla sembra soltanto una farfalla di taglia grossa, e invece è un'assassina addestrata. Vola come una farfalla innocua e punge come un'ape. Non bisogna farsi ingannare dall'aspetto.

jp: 探偵に化けて街に紛れ込む人狼。仲間の狼を処刑されないように、偽の証言で人々を振り回す。化けている間はつい吠えてしまわないように我慢しているのでストレスが溜まるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "探偵に化けて街に紛れ込む人狼。仲間の狼を処刑されないように、偽の証言で人々を振り回す。化けている間はつい吠えてしまわないように我慢しているのでストレスが溜まるらしい。"
en: A werewolf disguised as a detective blends in with the city. They sway people with false testimony to keep their fellow wolves from being executed. They seem to be under a lot of stress because they try not to bark while they are disguised.
en_grezzo: "A werewolf disguised as a detective blends in with the city. They sway people with false testimony to keep their fellow wolves from being executed. They seem to be under a lot of stress because they try not to bark while they are disguised."
it: Un lupo mannaro che si traveste da detective e si confonde fra la gente in città. Con testimonianze false porta tutti da una parte e dall'altra, per evitare che i lupi suoi compagni finiscano giustiziati. Mentre sta travestito deve trattenersi dall'ululare, e a quanto pare gli si accumula un bel po' di nervoso.

jp: 本能により事件の匂いを嗅ぎつける。事件が起きると決まって姿を現すため、何も悪くないのに人々から厄病神扱いされることも多い。そのことで精神を病み、とち狂って狼と友達になろうとする者もいる。
jp_grezzo: "本能により事件の匂いを嗅ぎつける。事件が起きると決まって姿を現すため、何も悪くないのに人々から厄病神扱いされることも多い。そのことで精神を病み、とち狂って狼と友達になろうとする者もいる。"
en: Instinctively he smells an incident. Because he always appears when an incident occurs he is often regarded by people as a god of disaster even though he has done nothing wrong. Some of them become mentally ill from this and try to make friends with wolves due to their madness.
en_grezzo: "Instinctively he smells an incident. Because he always appears when an incident occurs he is often regarded by people as a god of disaster even though he has done nothing wrong. Some of them become mentally ill from this and try to make friends with wolves due to their madness."
it: L'odore di un caso lo fiuta d'istinto. Siccome quando succede qualcosa lui è immancabilmente lì, la gente lo tratta spesso da portasfortuna, e dire che non ha colpa di niente. C'è chi per questo si ammala nella testa e, uscito di senno, prova a farsi amico un lupo.

jp: 精霊が獅子を象って実体化した存在。炎の力を纏って走る赤い獅子。五感を研ぎ澄ますことで眠れる力が開き、巨大化するとかしないとか。鋭い爪が武器。
jp_grezzo: "精霊が獅子を象って実体化した存在。炎の力を纏って走る赤い獅子。五感を研ぎ澄ますことで眠れる力が開き、巨大化するとかしないとか。鋭い爪が武器。"
en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a lion. A red lion running with the power of the flame. Perhaps by sharpening the five senses the power to sleep will open up and it will become huge or something. Sharp claws are their weapon.
en_grezzo: "A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a lion. A red lion running with the power of the flame. Perhaps by sharpening the five senses the power to sleep will open up and it will become huge or something. Sharp claws are their weapon."
it: Uno spirito che ha preso corpo nella forma di un leone. Un leone rosso che corre avvolto nella forza del fuoco. Dicono che affinando i cinque sensi gli si schiuda il potere che tiene addormentato dentro e diventi enorme, ma chi lo sa. La sua arma sono gli artigli aguzzi.

jp: 精霊が狼を象って実体化した存在。サーベルと光線銃を用いて戦う俊敏な狼。強いことは確かなのだが、どこかズレているところがある。銀色というより光る灰色に見えるがきっと気のせいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "精霊が狼を象って実体化した存在。サーベルと光線銃を用いて戦う俊敏な狼。強いことは確かなのだが、どこかズレているところがある。銀色というより光る灰色に見えるがきっと気のせいだろう。"
en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a wolf. An agile wolf who fights with a saber and a ray gun. They are strong for sure but there is something off about them. It appears to be a shiny gray rather than a silvery color but maybe it's just my imagination.
en_grezzo: "A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a wolf. An agile wolf who fights with a saber and a ray gun. They are strong for sure but there is something off about them. It appears to be a shiny gray rather than a silvery color but maybe it's just my imagination."
it: Uno spirito che ha preso corpo nella forma di un lupo. Un lupo svelto che combatte con una sciabola e una pistola a raggi. Che sia forte è fuori discussione, ma ha qualcosa che non gira per il verso giusto. Più che argento sembra un grigio che luccica, ma sarà un'impressione.

jp: 外法によってゾンビのような体になってしまった哀れな女性。さらに何者かの呪いによって著しく強化されている。感情は残っており、座り込み嘆き悲しんでいるところをよく目撃される。なお、近づくと爪で攻撃される。
jp_grezzo: "外法によってゾンビのような体になってしまった哀れな女性。さらに何者かの呪いによって著しく強化されている。感情は残っており、座り込み嘆き悲しんでいるところをよく目撃される。なお、近づくと爪で攻撃される。"
en: A poor woman who has been turned into a zombie-like entity by foreign laws. In addition it is significantly enhanced by the curse of some one. Their emotions remain and they are often seen sitting and grieving. It will attack with its claws if approached.
en_grezzo: "A poor woman who has been turned into a zombie-like entity by foreign laws. In addition it is significantly enhanced by the curse of some one. Their emotions remain and they are often seen sitting and grieving. It will attack with its claws if approached."
it: Una povera donna a cui le arti proibite hanno ridotto il corpo a quello di uno zombi. E per giunta la maledizione di qualcuno l'ha resa molto più forte. I sentimenti le sono rimasti, e spesso la si vede seduta a terra che si dispera. Attenzione però: se le ci si avvicina, colpisce con le unghie.

jp: 呪いによって、いつまでも狂ったように踊り続ける死者。盆踊りが得意らしいが、生者にはただの乱痴気騒ぎにしか見えない。それでも死者たちには概ね好評のようだ。
jp_grezzo: "呪いによって、いつまでも狂ったように踊り続ける死者。盆踊りが得意らしいが、生者にはただの乱痴気騒ぎにしか見えない。それでも死者たちには概ね好評のようだ。"
en: The dead dance like mad forever by a curse. Apparently they are really good at bon-dancing but to the living it looks like nothing more than an orgy. Still it seems to have been generally well received by the dead.
en_grezzo: "The dead dance like mad forever by a curse. Apparently they are really good at bon-dancing but to the living it looks like nothing more than an orgy. Still it seems to have been generally well received by the dead."
it: Un morto che una maledizione costringe a ballare all'infinito, come impazzito. Pare che sia bravissimo nel ballo dell'Obon, la festa dei morti, ma ai vivi sembra soltanto una baldoria sguaiata. Fra i morti, in compenso, riscuote un discreto successo.

jp: 死霊となった槍使い。元はただの衛兵だったが命を落とした際に呪いをかけられ生まれ変わった。知性が無く、割と力任せに突き刺すだけなので「鈍器などのほうが向いているのでは？」とよく言われる。
jp_grezzo: "死霊となった槍使い。元はただの衛兵だったが命を落とした際に呪いをかけられ生まれ変わった。知性が無く、割と力任せに突き刺すだけなので「鈍器などのほうが向いているのでは？」とよく言われる。"
en: A spearman who has become a spirit of death. It was once just a guard but when it lost its life it was cursed and reborn. It has no intelligence and only stabs at you with force perhaps a blunt instrument would be better suited.
en_grezzo: "A spearman who has become a spirit of death. It was once just a guard but when it lost its life it was cursed and reborn. It has no intelligence and only stabs at you with force perhaps a blunt instrument would be better suited."
it: Un lanciere diventato spettro. Prima era soltanto una guardia, ma quando ha perso la vita gli hanno gettato addosso una maledizione ed è rinato così. Di intelligenza non ne ha, e si limita a infilzare andando di forza bruta: c'è chi dice che gli starebbe meglio in mano un'arma contundente.

jp: 伝承に残るばかりの古代鳥と同じ姿、同じ名前を持つ謎の存在。主な生息地も、どこから来てどこへ行くのかも不明。ちなみに、やってきたコウノトリを追跡するのは昔からタブーとされている。
jp_grezzo: "伝承に残るばかりの古代鳥と同じ姿、同じ名前を持つ謎の存在。主な生息地も、どこから来てどこへ行くのかも不明。ちなみに、やってきたコウノトリを追跡するのは昔からタブーとされている。"
en: A mysterious being with the same appearance and name as an ancient bird that has only just been preserved in lore. Their primary habitat and where they come from and where they go are unknown. Incidentally it has long been taboo to pursue the storks that visit you.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious being with the same appearance and name as an ancient bird that has only just been preserved in lore. Their primary habitat and where they come from and where they go are unknown. Incidentally it has long been taboo to pursue the storks that visit you."
it: Un essere misterioso che ha l'aspetto e il nome di un uccello antico rimasto soltanto nei racconti. Non si sa dove viva, né da dove venga, né dove vada. Per inciso: seguire una cicogna che è venuta a trovarti è da sempre considerato tabù.

jp: ザナンの現場叩き上げの兵士。歴戦のつわものだが士官学校を出ておらず軍での地位も名声も低い。何も知らされずに危険な任務に駆り出されることも多い。
jp_grezzo: "ザナンの現場叩き上げの兵士。歴戦のつわものだが士官学校を出ておらず軍での地位も名声も低い。何も知らされずに危険な任務に駆り出されることも多い。"
en: Zanan's field-raised soldier. He is a war veteran but he has not graduated from officer's school and has a low rank and fame in the military. They are often sent out on dangerous missions without being informed.
en_grezzo: "Zanan's field-raised soldier. He is a war veteran but he has not graduated from officer's school and has a low rank and fame in the military. They are often sent out on dangerous missions without being informed."
it: Un soldato di Zanan venuto su dalla gavetta, sul campo. È un veterano di tante battaglie, ma l'accademia militare non l'ha fatta, e nell'esercito conta poco e non se lo fila nessuno. Spesso lo mandano in missioni pericolose senza dirgli niente.

jp: 頭に傷を負った少年。自分の名前以外を忘れた状態でネレスと共に倒れていた。礼儀正しく物腰も柔らかであり、かなり良好な家庭で育ったのではないかと言われているが真相は不明。
jp_grezzo: "頭に傷を負った少年。自分の名前以外を忘れた状態でネレスと共に倒れていた。礼儀正しく物腰も柔らかであり、かなり良好な家庭で育ったのではないかと言われているが真相は不明。"
en: A boy with a head injury. He collapsed with Neres in a state where he had forgotten everything but his own name. He is polite and soft-spoken and it is said that he may have grown up in a very good family but the truth is unknown.
en_grezzo: "A boy with a head injury. He collapsed with Neres in a state where he had forgotten everything but his own name. He is polite and soft-spoken and it is said that he may have grown up in a very good family but the truth is unknown."
it: Un ragazzo con una ferita alla testa. L'hanno trovato svenuto insieme a Neres, e di sé non ricordava altro che il proprio nome. È educato e ha modi gentili, e c'è chi dice che sia cresciuto in una famiglia più che agiata, ma come stiano davvero le cose non si sa.

jp: 子供の姿をしているが身体能力がやたらと高く、さらに戦闘慣れしている。記憶喪失だが、肝心なところが思い出せないだけで色々と断片は残っているのだとか。イルヴァの風景には全く見覚えが無いらしい。
jp_grezzo: "子供の姿をしているが身体能力がやたらと高く、さらに戦闘慣れしている。記憶喪失だが、肝心なところが思い出せないだけで色々と断片は残っているのだとか。イルヴァの風景には全く見覚えが無いらしい。"
en: Although she has the appearance of a child her physical abilities are extremely high and she is used to fighting. She has amnesia she just can't remember the important parts but there are many fragments left. Apparently she isn't at all familiar with the landscape of Irva.
en_grezzo: "Although she has the appearance of a child her physical abilities are extremely high and she is used to fighting. She has amnesia she just can't remember the important parts but there are many fragments left. Apparently she isn't at all familiar with the landscape of Irva."
it: Ha l'aspetto di una bambina, ma il fisico le risponde in modo fuori dal comune ed è abituata a combattere. Ha perso la memoria: solo che le sfugge proprio quello che conta, mentre i frammenti le sono rimasti a bizzeffe. E pare che i paesaggi di Irva non le dicano assolutamente niente.

jp: 元は木こりだったが身に覚えのない借金を押し付けられて破産し、怪しい男にザナン軍の研究施設へと拉致された。生体兵器への改造手術および劇薬投与に耐え、メシェーラの制御能力を得た後、脱走に成功。
jp_grezzo: "元は木こりだったが身に覚えのない借金を押し付けられて破産し、怪しい男にザナン軍の研究施設へと拉致された。生体兵器への改造手術および劇薬投与に耐え、メシェーラの制御能力を得た後、脱走に成功。"
en: He used to be a lumberjack but when he was forced into a debt he didn't recognize he went bankrupt and was abducted by a suspicious man to a research facility in Zanan's army. After enduring a bio-weapon modification surgery and the administration of heavy drugs he successfully escaped after gaining control of Meshera.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a lumberjack but when he was forced into a debt he didn't recognize he went bankrupt and was abducted by a suspicious man to a research facility in Zanan's army. After enduring a bio-weapon modification surgery and the administration of heavy drugs he successfully escaped after gaining control of Meshera."
it: Prima faceva il taglialegna, poi gli hanno addossato un debito che non aveva mai contratto: è fallito, e un uomo losco l'ha rapito e portato in un centro di ricerca dell'esercito di Zanan. Ha retto sia all'operazione che doveva farne un'arma biologica sia ai farmaci violenti, e quando ha ottenuto il controllo del Meshera è riuscito a fuggire.

jp: 観光の便宜を図るツアープランナー。必要とあらば未開の地にも超音速で赴くし、神とだって交渉する。足の速さと段取りの早さが自慢だが、手が出るのはもっと早い。リアという名前の妹がいる。
jp_grezzo: "観光の便宜を図るツアープランナー。必要とあらば未開の地にも超音速で赴くし、神とだって交渉する。足の速さと段取りの早さが自慢だが、手が出るのはもっと早い。リアという名前の妹がいる。"
en: A tour planner who works for the convenience of tourism. When necessary she travels at supersonic speed to the wilderness and even negotiates with gods. She prides herself on being quick on her feet and quick to set up things but she is even quicker to get her hands on things. She has a sister named Leah.
en_grezzo: "A tour planner who works for the convenience of tourism. When necessary she travels at supersonic speed to the wilderness and even negotiates with gods. She prides herself on being quick on her feet and quick to set up things but she is even quicker to get her hands on things. She has a sister named Leah."
it: Un'organizzatrice di viaggi che lavora perché il turista non abbia pensieri. Se serve raggiunge a velocità supersonica anche le terre inesplorate, e con gli dei tratta senza batter ciglio. Va fiera di avere il piede svelto e la scaletta pronta in un attimo, ma la mano ce l'ha ancora più svelta. Ha una sorella che si chiama Leah.

jp: 子供の頃、家出中に出会った異星の剣士と友人になり剣の腕を磨いたらしい。何十年経っても忘れないようにと、友の愛剣に似せたデザインの長剣を携帯している。
jp_grezzo: "子供の頃、家出中に出会った異星の剣士と友人になり剣の腕を磨いたらしい。何十年経っても忘れないようにと、友の愛剣に似せたデザインの長剣を携帯している。"
en: When he was a child he became friends with an alien swordsman he met while running away from home and honed his sword skills. He carries a long sword with a design similar to his friend's beloved sword so that he won't forget it even after decades.
en_grezzo: "When he was a child he became friends with an alien swordsman he met while running away from home and honed his sword skills. He carries a long sword with a design similar to his friend's beloved sword so that he won't forget it even after decades."
it: Da bambino, scappato di casa, fece amicizia con uno spadaccino venuto da un altro pianeta, e da lui imparò a maneggiare la lama. Porta con sé uno spadone disegnato sul modello della spada a cui l'amico teneva tanto, perché nemmeno dopo decine d'anni gli venga da dimenticarla.

jp: ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。おっとりとした性格のものが多く、気がつくと頭に小鳥などが止まっていたりする。
jp_grezzo: "ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。おっとりとした性格のものが多く、気がつくと頭に小鳥などが止まっていたりする。"
en: A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. Many of them have a calm personality and sometimes a small bird is perched on their head before they notice.
en_grezzo: "A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. Many of them have a calm personality and sometimes a small bird is perched on their head before they notice."
it: Un golem in formato ridotto. Che poi resta comunque grande all'incirca come un uomo. Quasi tutti hanno un carattere placido, e capita che si ritrovino un uccellino posato in testa senza essersene accorti.

jp: ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。ぶっきらぼうで石頭な性格だが、仕事を一心不乱に行う職人肌のものが多い。
jp_grezzo: "ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。ぶっきらぼうで石頭な性格だが、仕事を一心不乱に行う職人肌のものが多い。"
en: A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. It's a blunt and stubborn individual but there are many craftsmen who devote themselves to their work.
en_grezzo: "A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. It's a blunt and stubborn individual but there are many craftsmen who devote themselves to their work."
it: Un golem in formato ridotto. Che poi resta comunque grande all'incirca come un uomo. Ha modi bruschi e la testa dura come la pietra, ma sono in tanti ad avere l'animo dell'artigiano, e al lavoro ci si buttano anima e corpo.

jp: クトゥグアと互角の力を持つ炎の神。次元の扉の影に潜み、クトゥグアが召喚される際に紛れて現れる。焼くことと食べることしか頭になく、非常に危険な存在。
jp_grezzo: "クトゥグアと互角の力を持つ炎の神。次元の扉の影に潜み、クトゥグアが召喚される際に紛れて現れる。焼くことと食べることしか頭になく、非常に危険な存在。"
en: A fire god with power equal to that of Cthugha. It lurks in the shadows of the dimensional door and appears among the cthughas when they are summoned. They are very dangerous with only burning and consuming in their minds.
en_grezzo: "A fire god with power equal to that of Cthugha. It lurks in the shadows of the dimensional door and appears among the cthughas when they are summoned. They are very dangerous with only burning and consuming in their minds."
it: Un dio del fuoco che sta alla pari col Cthugha. Se ne sta acquattato nell'ombra della porta fra le dimensioni, e quando qualcuno evoca il Cthugha compare insieme a lui, confondendosi. In testa non ha altro che bruciare e mangiare, ed è pericolosissimo.

jp: 異星からやってきた炎の神。人間とは別に敵対しているわけではなく、場合によっては意思疎通も可能。だが戦闘となれば森だろうが街だろうがナイアーラトテップだろうが焼き尽くすのでやっぱり危険。
jp_grezzo: "異星からやってきた炎の神。人間とは別に敵対しているわけではなく、場合によっては意思疎通も可能。だが戦闘となれば森だろうが街だろうがナイアーラトテップだろうが焼き尽くすのでやっぱり危険。"
en: A fire god from a different world. They are not antagonistic to humans and can communicate with them in some cases. But when it comes to battle the forest the city and the nyarlathotep will burn to the ground.
en_grezzo: "A fire god from a different world. They are not antagonistic to humans and can communicate with them in some cases. But when it comes to battle the forest the city and the nyarlathotep will burn to the ground."
it: Un dio del fuoco arrivato da un altro pianeta. Con gli uomini non ce l'ha in modo particolare, e a volte ci si può perfino parlare. Ma se si arriva alle mani brucia tutto fino all'ultimo: la foresta, la città e anche il Nyarlathotep. Quindi resta pericoloso.

jp: 海の支配者として崇拝されていた神だが、他の海神たちとの勢力争いに敗北。その力の欠片は蟹の営巣地に降り注ぎ蟹を操る魔物に転生した。その経緯から、神の頃から蟹しか操れなかったとよく勘違いされる。
jp_grezzo: "海の支配者として崇拝されていた神だが、他の海神たちとの勢力争いに敗北。その力の欠片は蟹の営巣地に降り注ぎ蟹を操る魔物に転生した。その経緯から、神の頃から蟹しか操れなかったとよく勘違いされる。"
en: A god who was worshipped as the ruler of the sea was defeated in a power struggle with the other sea gods. A piece of the power fell on the crab's nesting grounds and transformed into a crab-controlling demon. Because of this it is often mistakenly assumed that he has only been able to control crabs since he was a deity.
en_grezzo: "A god who was worshipped as the ruler of the sea was defeated in a power struggle with the other sea gods. A piece of the power fell on the crab's nesting grounds and transformed into a crab-controlling demon. Because of this it is often mistakenly assumed that he has only been able to control crabs since he was a deity."
it: Era un dio venerato come signore del mare, ma nella lotta per il potere con gli altri dei marini fu sconfitto. Una scheggia di quel potere piovve su un covo di granchi e rinacque come mostro che comanda i granchi. Per via di questa storia si crede spesso, a torto, che anche da dio non sapesse comandare altro che granchi.

jp: 漆黒の立方体。自律型の機械であるとされるが内部構造は完全に不明。熱線や破壊光線を出すほか、周囲に撹乱用の霧を発生させる機能を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "漆黒の立方体。自律型の機械であるとされるが内部構造は完全に不明。熱線や破壊光線を出すほか、周囲に撹乱用の霧を発生させる機能を持つ。"
en: A jet-black cube. It is said to be an autonomous machine but its internal structure is completely unknown. In addition to emitting heat and destructive rays it also has the ability to create a disturbing fog around it.
en_grezzo: "A jet-black cube. It is said to be an autonomous machine but its internal structure is completely unknown. In addition to emitting heat and destructive rays it also has the ability to create a disturbing fog around it."
it: Un cubo nero come la pece. Si dice che sia una macchina che si governa da sola, ma di come sia fatta dentro non si sa proprio niente. Oltre a sparare raggi ardenti e raggi distruttori, sa spandersi attorno una nebbia che confonde.

jp: 地下遺跡から発見された謎の機械。凄まじい耐久性を持っているため、これは本来鈍器であり電子部品は何らかの理由で後から組み込まれたのでないかという学説まで出ている。
jp_grezzo: "地下遺跡から発見された謎の機械。凄まじい耐久性を持っているため、これは本来鈍器であり電子部品は何らかの理由で後から組み込まれたのでないかという学説まで出ている。"
en: A mysterious machine discovered in the underground ruins. Because of its tremendous durability there is even a theory that it was originally a blunt instrument and the electronic components were built in later for some reason.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious machine discovered in the underground ruins. Because of its tremendous durability there is even a theory that it was originally a blunt instrument and the electronic components were built in later for some reason."
it: Una macchina misteriosa ritrovata in certe rovine sotterranee. Regge i colpi in un modo tale che c'è perfino chi sostiene, per via accademica, che in origine fosse un'arma contundente e che i pezzi elettronici gliel'abbiano montati dopo, chissà per quale ragione.

jp: 金属と宝石を司る中級神にして、大地の神の姉。大地の神の力を勝手に使って自分をモデルとした黄金の騎士を作り、騎士団を率いている。その豪胆さには大地の神も苦笑いするという。
jp_grezzo: "金属と宝石を司る中級神にして、大地の神の姉。大地の神の力を勝手に使って自分をモデルとした黄金の騎士を作り、騎士団を率いている。その豪胆さには大地の神も苦笑いするという。"
en: She is mid-level god of metals and gems and the sister of the earth god. Using the power of the God of the Earth at her disposal she created a golden knight modeled after herself to lead the Order. It is said that the god of the earth laughs at her boldness.
en_grezzo: "She is mid-level god of metals and gems and the sister of the earth god. Using the power of the God of the Earth at her disposal she created a golden knight modeled after herself to lead the Order. It is said that the god of the earth laughs at her boldness."
it: È la divinità di medio rango che ha in mano i metalli e le gemme, ed è la sorella maggiore del dio della terra. Usando il potere del fratello senza chiedergli permesso si è fabbricata dei cavalieri dorati a propria immagine, e adesso guida i Cavalieri Dorati. Dicono che davanti a tanta sfrontatezza perfino il dio della terra rida amaro.
